internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: We are now in the final moments of the Can Felipa concession, which we have managed from its inception 34 years ago. The City Council has made the decision, which we welcome, to dedicate the entire building to sports uses and completely renew the pool basin, transforming it into a 33-meter pool suitable for high-level competition. Needless to say, we are thrilled and will work hard to continue managing the concession.

The equipment of the CEM Besòs in Sant Adrià continues its slow consolidation after having suffered considerably the effects of the closure caused by the pandemic. Thanks to its water surface, we can accommodate the training and competition of our two aquatic sections.
